description: This file defines the MessageException class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, representing a custom exception class that extends std::exception. It declares constructors, a destructor, and a method to retrieve the exception message, along with a private member variable for storing the message.

classes.name: MessageException
classes.description: A custom exception class that extends std::exception, providing message handling capabilities.

methods.name: MessageException(const string& message, bool inclSysMsg = false)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and optional system message inclusion flag.

methods.name: Message()
methods.description: Returns the exception message as a TCHAR pointer.
